title: Primary Source Corroboration
intent: A summary without its primary source is an assertion — the operator names this the Memento problem. It surfaced on three surfaces in a single session (2026-08-07): a Step-4b adversarial verdict with no ARB receipt proving a critic ran (GHI #765); an authored handoff with no reference to the transcript it was drawn from; and ADR-pool.convergence-moment-cross-family-critic, built from handoffs ABOUT its design sessions rather than from the sessions themselves. The operator diagnosed the third in flight, verbatim: 'multiple audio tape recordings of audio tape recordings where the quality is dissipating rapidly.' The actual defect is a LIFETIME MISMATCH: a citation is corroboration only while its referent exists. Session transcripts are deleted on a rolling window; ADRs, campaigns and doctrine are permanent. A permanent artifact citing an ephemeral source is corroborated on the day it is written and uncorroborated forever after, with nothing in the artifact signalling the transition.
decision:
1. A summary artifact must cite the primary source that corroborates it.
2. The corroboration window must match the artifact's lifetime — pointers for short-lived artifacts (handoffs, session_exit_uncovered: days), archived passages in-package for permanent ones (ADR, campaign, doctrine).
3. Governing design principle derived from reversibility: LIBERAL WITH POINTERS, CONSERVATIVE WITH ARCHIVES. A pointer field is a two-way door (additive, nullable, droppable). An archived appendix is a one-way door — once in git history, removal costs git filter-repo plus a force-push.
4. Three required properties of a transcript reference: (a) PORTABLE — session_id plus a resolver, never a raw absolute filesystem path; (b) LIVENESS-SIGNALLED — carries the source's expiry estimate, or a validator flags dangling references, because a pointer with no liveness signal reads as corroborated when it is dead; (c) PRODUCER-STAMPED — written by the handoff writer at authoring time, never left to authoring convention.
5. Archiving a passage carries a MANDATORY SCRUB-BEFORE-COMMIT obligation; the standing operator-PII prohibition is binding on appendices. Doctrine-level obligation, not a mechanical gate (operator ruled).
6. The two corroboration paths are NOT equivalent and must never be presented as such: an authored handoff counter-checked against its transcript is the higher-quality path; the session_exit_uncovered -> SessionStart -> agent-reads-transcript path is the floor.
positive_consequences:
1. Closes a defect class rather than three instances — the same wound on Step 4b, handoffs, and ADRs gets one decision home.
2. The higher-quality path (handoff carrying its transcript) is cheap: an additive nullable field plus a producer stamp.
3. Producer-stamping is the countermeasure to gzkit's measured convention decay (@advances zero registrations; tasks: 7 of 534 before stamping; commit trailer ~15% authored). The mechanism is already proven in this repo.
4. Portability makes corroboration work for readers who are not the operator on the operator's machine — today every transcript reference in the corpus fails that test.
5. The archive half already has working precedent: ADR-pool.convergence-moment-cross-family-critic/appendices/ preserved an operator exhibit that survived only because it was still base64-embedded in a transcript whose image cache had been cleared.
negative_consequences:
1. Corroboration theater: an agent cites a transcript path without reading it, satisfying the gate while the summary stays uncorroborated. This is metagaming — pattern 9 in .gzkit/rules/agent-failure-modes.md.
2. The doctrine buys PRESENCE of a primary source, not CORRESPONDENCE. Nothing checks that an archived appendix actually corroborates the claim beside it; an unrelated passage passes as well as the right one.
3. The archive half is a one-way door into git history, and raw transcripts can carry operator PII — a documented path to re-running the 2026-04-19 leak incident if the scrub obligation is not kept.
4. Repo weight: permanent artifacts accrete archived passages; clone size and grep noise grow.
5. A transcript is primary for what was SAID, not for what was MEANT. Reading it as settled intent is a second-order version of the same over-trust this ADR corrects.
checklist:
1. A structured, PORTABLE transcript reference on HandoffFrontmatter, added as a DECLARED field — extra='forbid' is load-bearing (src/gzkit/handoff_validation.py:128-131, OBPI-0.0.72-02: 'Dropping the guard is forbidden') and must not be relaxed.
2. Producer stamp: the handoff writer populates that field at authoring time, mirroring how gz task start stamps tasks:.
3. The session_exit_uncovered ledger event carrying session_id and a portable transcript reference. Closes an existing asymmetry: ledger_events.py:1050 defines session_exit_bookmark_skipped_event with no corresponding ..._written_event, so the beat books its non-actions and not its actions.
4. SessionStart orientation reads that event and directs the incoming agent to consult the named transcript.
5. Generalize the ADR-appendix pattern, including the requirement that formatters never rewrite archived evidence (.pre-commit-config.yaml already excludes docs/design/adr/.*/appendices/ from end-of-file-fixer and trailing-whitespace — a formatter that rewrites a primary source destroys the one property it must have).
6. Liveness: expiry estimate on the reference, or a validator flagging dangling references.
alternatives:
1. POINTER-ONLY (every artifact cites a path, nothing archived): REJECTED — fails for permanent artifacts whose lifetime exceeds the source's. A pointer alone dangles.
2. ARCHIVE-EVERYTHING (every artifact carries its passages in-package): REJECTED — the archive half is a one-way door and the storage plus selection cost is unjustified for artifacts that live days.
3. EXTEND cleanupPeriodDays (widen transcript retention): REJECTED — on its face the cheapest fix, and it is rejected for a specific reason: retention config is machine-local and does not travel with the repo. It helps one operator on one machine and nothing else, and it cannot make a window permanent, only longer.
4. A RULE INSTEAD OF AN ADR: WITHDRAWN by operator challenge, verbatim 'ok, but why not an adr?'. In gzkit rules are the enforcement surface for an ADR's decision (15 of 26 rules under .gzkit/rules/ reference an ADR id, measured 2026-08-07); a rule would come after this decision as its enforcement arm, not instead of it. Recorded because the agent proposed it and was corrected — the correction is part of the decision record.
pre_mortem: 18 months on, the most likely failure is that the field shipped and went inert — exactly what happened to @advances (zero registrations) and to tasks: before it was producer-stamped. Second most likely: dangling-by-construction absolute paths; already instantiated, since the handoff resumed to author this ADR cites /Users/jeff/.claude/projects/... which is dead for every other reader and machine. Third: corroboration theater, agents citing without reading. Fourth: archive bloat making the repo hostile. Mitigations are the three required properties in the decision — producer-stamped answers failure 1, portable answers failure 2, and nothing yet answers failure 3.
wwhtbt: For this to be the right decision it must be true that transcripts contain the corroborating detail (PROVEN — the 2026-08-07 recovery pulled the CRM framing, both PERFORATED adversary verdicts, and the 239-AskUserQuestion-calls-against-41,624-assistant-turns figure, none of which any handoff carried); that agents actually read them when pointed; and that the retention window exceeds the artifact lifetime for pointer-class artifacts. SHAKIEST CONDITION and the single biggest risk: that agents actually read the pointer. SessionStart can DIRECT a read; direction is not verification, and nothing distinguishes 'read and corroborated' from 'saw the path'. For archive-everything to have been better, repo weight would have to be a non-issue and the selection cost of trimming passages higher than the storage cost of keeping all of them.
constraint_archaeology: The ~30-day transcript window is INHERITED, not real: cleanupPeriodDays is unset, so the window is a Claude Code default and is configurable. Measured 2026-08-07 — the oldest surviving transcript was exactly 30 days. It must be treated as a currently-observed value, never as a constant to design against. By contrast extra='forbid' on HandoffFrontmatter IS real and load-bearing: src/gzkit/handoff_validation.py:128-131 keeps it deliberately with every real field declared as an explicit superset under OBPI-0.0.72-02, comment verbatim 'Dropping the guard is forbidden.' The new field joins that superset; the guard is not relaxed.
assumption_surfacing: 1. IMPLICIT AND FALSE: that corroboration is verifiable. Nothing checks correspondence between an archived appendix and the claim it corroborates. 2. IMPLICIT: that a transcript is the primary source — it is primary for utterances, not for intent. 3. INVERTED CORE ASSUMPTION, the strongest argument against this whole ADR: maybe summaries are fine and the real defect is HOP COUNT. The critic design degraded across three handoffs ('tape recordings of tape recordings'), and fewer hops would have preserved it with no corroboration machinery at all. If that diagnosis is right, this ADR buys a channel where a sequencing discipline would have sufficed. Recorded rather than assumed away; a promoting session should answer it.
reversibility: Split, and the split drives the design. The pointer field is a TWO-WAY DOOR — additive, nullable, droppable in one commit. Archived appendices are a ONE-WAY DOOR — once in git history, removal costs git filter-repo plus a force-push, the same recovery the standing operator-PII rule names after the 2026-04-19 incident. Hence the governing principle: liberal with pointers, conservative with archives.
operator_2am: On-call at 2am, a handoff cites a transcript that no longer exists. The design as captured gives the operator nothing: no expiry estimate on the reference, no validator flagging dangling references, and an absolute machine-local path that cannot be checked from another machine. A pointer with no liveness signal is worse than no pointer, because it READS as corroborated. Decision items 4(a) portable and 4(b) liveness-signalled are the response to this scenario specifically.
scope_minimization: Smallest version that delivers value: the handoff transcript field ALONE (checklist items 1 and 2) — the path the operator ranked higher-quality, verbatim 'I should get HIGHER QUALITY results when I call for a handoff that the ounter-checks the transcript'. session_exit_uncovered is explicitly the floor and can land later. At half the time: ship the field and leave bookmark retirement to GHI #766. Note the ordering constraint — retiring the mechanical bookmark removes the only reliable transcript citer in the system, so landing retirement first is a net loss of corroboration.
downstream_adrs: Forces a ruling on which ADR owns HandoffFrontmatter — the session record names ADR-0.0.65 (handoff-system-consolidation) while the model's own comment credits OBPI-0.0.72-02 for the explicit-superset design the new field must join; deliberately left unresolved here. May force a decision on whether transcript-retention configuration should travel with the repo rather than the machine. May force a size and redaction policy for ADR appendices, which interacts directly with the standing operator-PII prohibition. GHI #766 remains the tracked home for the bookmark-retirement half and is coupled to this ADR's channel half.
